runtime_issue_found.description: Evolution was GPU-backed, but live orbital diagnostics pulled full 3D fields to NumPy at checkpoint cadence.

claude_equation_audit_findings.non_variational_ledger_semantics: The frozen TG-B1S phi/T/G model is phenomenological and non-variational; energy ledger closure is diagnostic, not an exact conserved-energy contract.
claude_equation_audit_findings.sign_chain_design_gate: The implemented S_state -> T -> G -> A chain creates an A-hill near the node. This is acceptable for self-frequency-shift auditing but must be decided explicitly before two-node attraction tests.
claude_equation_audit_findings.frequency_contract_status: FC-1 closed with TG_B1S_FREQUENCY_CONTRACT_SIGN_MATCH_ONLY. The prior sign puzzle is superseded: delta_omega_infty is a phase-difference slope and physical delta_omega is its negative, giving a positive physical shift consistent with A-hill stiffening.
claude_equation_audit_findings.frequency_contract_mechanism: Measured physical delta_omega is +2.150936882840006e-06, bracketed by fixed-profile +5.398e-07 and fixed-Q envelope +4.690e-06 limits. Interpretation: quasi-static geometric stiffening with partial profile relaxation.
claude_equation_audit_findings.dealiasing_note: The RK4 TG-B1S path does not restore the older C3 dealiasing mask; current evidence does not show aliasing failure, but sharper future TG runs need an explicit dealiasing audit.

run_queue.status_vocabulary: PROPOSED -> QUEUED -> ACTIVE -> REVIEW -> DONE / DROPPED / BLOCKED(gate)
run_queue.purpose: Shared planning queue for proposed runs, tests and checks so agent recommendations are not lost in conversation.

scientific_boundary: A passing D4/D5 result would support only a numerically converged and orbitally bounded modal-frequency shift in the tested state-load T/G feedback model. It would not establish gravity, geodesic motion, objective chronology, photon emission, universal free fall, production readiness or IRER validation.
